programs.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programs.desc: You thought your job was tough? Uncover the dangerous gigs of the past – from mercury-poisoned hat makers to kids crawling through chimneys – and imagine the risks behind everyday jobs of old.

programs.title: Ancient Aliens
programs.desc: The ancient Sumerians established the world's first civilisation, and they credited their achievements to their gods, the Anunnaki. But is it possible these powerful beings were extraterrestrial visitors.

programs.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
programs.desc: Are modern-day pirates prowling the Bermuda Triangle in search of victims? The team takes on the twisted case of a missing boat called the Saba Bank lost in the vicinity of the Bermuda Triangle in 1974.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Lauro nears the end of the Iditarod, crossing 260 miles of ice along the Bering Sea coast to reach the finish line in Nome; Marty and his friend Dave haul supplies for a cabin into the backcountry.

programs.title: Forged In Fire
programs.sub_title: Beat The Unbeaten: Off The Hook
programs.desc: Two previous champions will face off in a gruelling five-hour challenge, making a blade inspired by Hollywood for the chance to duke it out against one of our titans of the forge.

programs.title: Swamp People
programs.desc: A drought and sweltering temperatures drop water levels to their lowest point in decades, and access to the best honey holes in the swamp are nearly impassable. Hunters take huge risks to fill tags.
